messages: We did it. The product launched and the reviews are coming in and they're incredible.
I've been awake for 36 hours and I've never felt more alive in my life.
People are actually using what we built. Real people. Thousands of them.
I just saw a tweet from someone saying it changed how they work. I cried at my desk. Don't tell anyone.
Every late night, every moment of doubt — it was all worth this exact moment.
I'm so proud of this team. We built something real and it matters.
My co-founder just called and we couldn't even speak for a second, just laughing.
I want to remember exactly how this feels. This joy, this exhaustion, this pride.
Here's to everyone who said it couldn't be done.
The real work starts now and I cannot wait.
